package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for body_binding_done_in_middleware_and_handler: Endpoints where middleware parses the body and the handler also owns body binding.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type CreateUserRequest struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func bodyParsingMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		bodyBytes, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		r.Body.Close()

		var parsed CreateUserRequest
		json.Unmarshal(bodyBytes, &parsed)

		r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewBuffer(bodyBytes))
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func createUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to read body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var req CreateUserRequest
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bodyBytes, &req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid JSON", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"name": req.Name, "email": req.Email})
}
